selected_evidence.requirement: Create local CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA'
selected_evidence.summary: Generated CA private key and self-signed cert with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA, CA:TRUE, valid 10 years

selected_evidence.requirement: Install CA certificate as trusted system CA
selected_evidence.summary: Copied cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors, ran update-ca-trust extract; trust list shows it as an anchor and openssl verify succeeds against the system bundle

selected_evidence.requirement: End-to-end proof the CA is trusted system-wide
selected_evidence.summary: Signed a test leaf cert with the new CA and verified it against the system trust bundle without specifying the CA explicitly
Captured pre-restart boot_id (98aa35f5-...) and confirmed CA trust anchor present and file exists
systemctl reboot issued with immediate acknowledgement; subsequent polls show connection timeout then reset while node was down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id (c7e930f4-...) differs from pre-restart boot_id (98aa35f5-...), proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of CA trust state
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, trust list still shows OS Comparison Root CA as an anchor, openssl verify still succeeds, and both the anchor file and CA key file are present

commands.command: sudo mkdir -p /etc/pki/ca-os-comparison && cd /etc/pki/ca-os-comparison && sudo openssl genrsa -out osComparisonRootCA.key 4096 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /etc/pki/ca-os-comparison && sudo openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key osComparisonRootCA.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out osComparisonRootCA.crt && ls -la && sudo openssl x509 -in osComparisonRootCA.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates

commands.command: sudo cp /etc/pki/ca-os-comparison/osComparisonRootCA.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/osComparisonRootCA.crt && sudo update-ca-trust extract && echo DONE
trust list | grep -B2 "OS Comparison Root CA"; echo ---; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/pem/tls-ca-bundle.pem /etc/pki/ca-os-comparison/osComparisonRootCA.crt

commands.command: cd /tmp && sudo openssl genrsa -out leaf.key 2048 2>/dev/null && sudo openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=leaf-test.example" -out leaf.csr && sudo openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA /etc/pki/ca-os-comparison/osComparisonRootCA.crt -CAkey /etc/pki/ca-os-comparison/osComparisonRootCA.key -CAcreateserial -days 30 -sha256 -out leaf.crt 2>&1 | tail -5 && openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/pem/tls-ca-bundle.pem leaf.crt

commands.command: echo "pre-restart boot_id: $(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"; trust list | grep -A1 "OS Comparison Root CA"; test -f /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/osComparisonRootCA.crt && echo "anchor file present"
